title: Sprint planning maps each goal clause to an item
goal: /kb-sprint plan checks that each clause of the sprint goal is carried by a committed item, and drops a clause already met in the tree (naming the earlier item) before the operator approves; kb/_self/backlog.md Sprints says the same. Answers the SP-rhgeod5g failure: two goal clauses (kb-worker reads kb/_self by section; test_research_merge ignores sprint worktrees) were delivered before the sprint started, so no item carried them and close --summary could not name one.
